_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtype" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "official_name" TEXT NULL, "mask" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_balance_minor" INTEGER NULL, "available_balance_minor" INTEGER NULL, "credit_limit_minor" INTEGER NULL, "balances_as_of" INTEGER NULL, "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "display_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (type IN ('depository', 'credit', 'loan', 'investment', 'other')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "authorized_date" TEXT NULL, "pending" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("pending" IN (0, 1)), "pending_transaction_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant_name" TEXT NULL, "merchant_logo_url" TEXT NULL, "plaid_primary_category" TEXT NULL, "plaid_detailed_category" TEXT NULL, "user_category_id" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "receipt_path" TEXT NULL, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted_with_account" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted_with_account" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (source IN ('plaid', 'manual', 'import', 'derived', 'demo')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_tags" ("transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("transaction_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_splits" ("transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("transaction_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plaid_category" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "change_log" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synced" IN (0, 1)), "rejected_reason" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record_clocks" ("entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity_type", "entity_id", "field"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "held_records" ("entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fields" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity_type", "entity_id"), CHECK (reason IN ('incomplete', 'unrepresentable', 'unknown_fields', 'unsupported_type')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "institution_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "institution_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "institution_logo_url" TEXT NULL, "institution_logo" BLOB NULL, "institution_color" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "last_successful_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "pulled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (status IN ('healthy', 'login_required', 'error', 'pending_expiration', 'unknown', 'removed')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "conditions" TEXT NOT NULL, "actions" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_start_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "rollover" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("rollover" IN (0, 1)), "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (period IN ('monthly')), CHECK (period_start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 28));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_alerts" ("budget_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_start" TEXT NOT NULL, "threshold_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "raised_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("budget_id", "period_start", "threshold_bp"));
CREATE INDEX transactions_account_date ON transactions (account_id, date)
CREATE INDEX transactions_user_category ON transactions (user_category_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_pending_transaction ON transactions (pending_transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX transaction_tags_tag ON transaction_tags (tag)
CREATE INDEX categories_parent ON categories (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX change_log_outbox ON change_log (synced, rejected_reason, hlc)
CREATE INDEX record_clocks_hlc ON record_clocks (hlc)
CREATE INDEX rules_position ON rules (position)
CREATE INDEX budgets_category ON budgets (category_id)
